  function v4.applySky(key4)
    if key4 == "Padrão" then
      f16()

      for _, value9 in ipairs(list2) do
        value9.Parent = lighting
      end

      list2 = {}
      f15()
      return
    end

    local v31 = v30[key4]

    if not v31 then
      return
    end

    f14()
    f16()

    for _, value10 in ipairs(lighting:GetChildren()) do
      if value10:IsA("Sky") then
        table.insert(list2, value10)
        value10.Parent = nil
      end
    end

    f15()

    for key5, value11 in pairs(v31.Lighting) do
      lighting[key5] = value11
    end

    local nexoraSky = Instance.new("Sky")
    nexoraSky.Name = "NexoraSky"
    nexoraSky.SkyboxBk = v31.Sky.Bk
    nexoraSky.SkyboxDn = v31.Sky.Dn
    nexoraSky.SkyboxFt = v31.Sky.Ft
    nexoraSky.SkyboxLf = v31.Sky.Lf
    nexoraSky.SkyboxRt = v31.Sky.Rt
    nexoraSky.SkyboxUp = v31.Sky.Up
    nexoraSky.CelestialBodiesShown = v31.Celestial ~= false

    if v31.Sun then
      nexoraSky.SunTextureId = v31.Sun
    end

    nexoraSky.Parent = lighting
    instance7 = nexoraSky

    if v31.Rain then
      makeFolder()
    end
  end

  local map2 = {}

  local function getIsfolder()
    return writefile and readfile and isfile and makefolder and isfolder
  end

  local function f17()
    if not getIsfolder() then
      return false
    end

    return (pcall(function()
      if not isfolder("NexoraHub") then
        makefolder("NexoraHub")
      end

      writefile("NexoraHub/skyboxes.json", httpService:JSONEncode(map2))
    end))
  end

  local function f18()
    if not getIsfolder() or not isfile("NexoraHub/skyboxes.json") then
      return
    end

    local ok3, result3 = pcall(function()
      return httpService:JSONDecode(readfile("NexoraHub/skyboxes.json"))
    end)

    if not ok3 or type(result3) ~= "table" then
      return
    end

    for key6, value12 in pairs(result3) do
      if type(key6) == "string" and type(value12) == "table" and #value12 == 6 then
        map2[key6] = value12
      end
    end
  end

  f18()

  function v4.parseSkyIds(p15)
    local list4 = {}

    for match in tostring(p15 or ""):gmatch("%d+") do
      if #match >= 5 then
        table.insert(list4, match)
      end
    end

    if #list4 == 1 then
      return { list4[1], list4[1], list4[1], list4[1], list4[1], list4[1] }
    end

    if #list4 == 6 then
      return list4
    end

    return nil
  end

  function v4.applyCustomSky(p16)
    f14()
    f16()
    f15()

    for _, value13 in ipairs(lighting:GetChildren()) do
      if value13:IsA("Sky") then
        table.insert(list2, value13)
        value13.Parent = nil
      end
    end

    local nexoraSky2 = Instance.new("Sky")
    nexoraSky2.Name = "NexoraSky"
    nexoraSky2.SkyboxBk = "rbxassetid://" .. p16[1]
    nexoraSky2.SkyboxDn = "rbxassetid://" .. p16[2]
    nexoraSky2.SkyboxFt = "rbxassetid://" .. p16[3]
    nexoraSky2.SkyboxLf = "rbxassetid://" .. p16[4]
    nexoraSky2.SkyboxRt = "rbxassetid://" .. p16[5]
    nexoraSky2.SkyboxUp = "rbxassetid://" .. p16[6]
    nexoraSky2.CelestialBodiesShown = false
    nexoraSky2.Parent = lighting

    instance7 = nexoraSky2
  end

  local map3 = {}

  local function makeSpecialMesh(descendant3, p18)
    pcall(function()
      if not map3[descendant3] then
        local v33 = { Decals = {}, Color = descendant3.Color, Material = descendant3.Material }

        if descendant3:IsA("MeshPart") then
          v33.MeshId = descendant3.MeshId
          v33.TextureID = descendant3.TextureID
        else
          local specialMesh = descendant3:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")

          if specialMesh then
            v33.Mesh = {
              MeshId = specialMesh.MeshId,
              TextureId = specialMesh.TextureId,
              MeshType = specialMesh.MeshType,
            }
          end
        end

        for _, value14 in ipairs(descendant3:GetChildren()) do
          if value14:IsA("Decal") or value14:IsA("Texture") then
            v33.Decals[value14] = {
              Texture = value14.Texture,
              Transparency = value14.Transparency,
            }
          end
        end

        map3[descendant3] = v33
      end

      if p18.Color then
        descendant3.Color = p18.Color
        descendant3.Material = p18.Material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic

        if descendant3:IsA("MeshPart") then
          descendant3.TextureID = ""
        else
          local specialMesh2 = descendant3:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")

          if specialMesh2 then
            specialMesh2.TextureId = ""
          end
        end

        for _, value15 in ipairs(descendant3:GetChildren()) do
          if value15:IsA("Decal") or value15:IsA("Texture") then
            value15.Transparency = 1
          end
        end

        return
      end

      descendant3.Color = map3[descendant3].Color
      descendant3.Material = map3[descendant3].Material

      if descendant3:IsA("MeshPart") then
        if p18.Mesh then
          descendant3.MeshId = p18.Mesh
        end

        descendant3.TextureID = p18.Texture
      else
        local nexoraSkinMesh = descendant3:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")

        if not nexoraSkinMesh and p18.Mesh then
          nexoraSkinMesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
          nexoraSkinMesh.Name = "NexoraSkinMesh"
          nexoraSkinMesh.Parent = descendant3

          map3[descendant3].CreatedMesh = true
        end

        if nexoraSkinMesh then
          if p18.Mesh then
            nexoraSkinMesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
            nexoraSkinMesh.MeshId = p18.Mesh
          end

          nexoraSkinMesh.TextureId = p18.Texture
        end
      end

      for _, value16 in ipairs(descendant3:GetChildren()) do
        if value16:IsA("Decal") or value16:IsA("Texture") then
          value16.Texture = p18.Texture
          value16.Transparency = 0
        end
      end
    end)
  end

  local function f19(key11)
    local v34 = map3[key11]

    if not v34 then
      return
    end

    pcall(function()
      if v34.Color then
        key11.Color = v34.Color
        key11.Material = v34.Material
      end

      if key11:IsA("MeshPart") then
        if v34.MeshId then
          key11.MeshId = v34.MeshId
        end

        if v34.TextureID then
          key11.TextureID = v34.TextureID
        end
      else
        local specialMesh3 = key11:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")

        if specialMesh3 then
          if v34.CreatedMesh then
            specialMesh3:Destroy()
          elseif v34.Mesh then
            specialMesh3.MeshType = v34.Mesh.MeshType
            specialMesh3.MeshId = v34.Mesh.MeshId
            specialMesh3.TextureId = v34.Mesh.TextureId
          end
        end
      end

      for key12, value17 in pairs(v34.Decals) do
        if key12.Parent then
          key12.Texture = value17.Texture
          key12.Transparency = value17.Transparency
        end
      end
    end)

    map3[key11] = nil
  end

  end

  workspaceService.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant4)
    if v35 and f2(descendant4) then

  local v38 = { enabled = false, range = 15 }
  local flag4 = false
  local v39 = 0

  local function f22(_, humanoidRootPart11, humanoid5)
    local hipHeight = humanoid5 and humanoid5.HipHeight or 2
    return humanoidRootPart11.Position.Y - hipHeight
  end

  runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not v38.enabled then
      return
    elseif not f10() then
      return
    elseif flag4 then
      return
    end

    if tick() - v39 < 1.2 then
      return
    end

    local character11 = localPlayer.Character

    if not character11 then
      return
    end

    local humanoidRootPart12 = character11:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local v40 = not humanoidRootPart12
    local humanoid6 = character11:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if v40 or not humanoid6 or humanoid6.Health <= 0 then
      return
    end

    local instance8 = f4(humanoidRootPart12)

    if not instance8 or not instance8.Parent then
      return
    end

    local v41 = instance8.Position - humanoidRootPart12.Position
    local magnitude2 = v41.Magnitude

    if magnitude2 > v38.range then
      return
    end

    local v42 = instance8.Position.Y - f22(character11, humanoidRootPart12, humanoid6)

    if magnitude2 <= 8 and v42 > 2 then
      flag4 = true
      v39 = tick()
      task.delay(1.2, function() flag4 = false end)
      return
    end

    local currentCamera2 = workspaceService.CurrentCamera
    local cframe = currentCamera2 and currentCamera2.CFrame or humanoidRootPart12.CFrame

    if v41:Dot(cframe.LookVector) > 0 and v42 <= 1.5 then
      local flag5 = false

      for _, value19 in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
        if value19 ~= localPlayer and value19.Character then
          local humanoidRootPart13 = value19.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

          if humanoidRootPart13
            and (humanoidRootPart13.Position - instance8.Position).Magnitude <= 6 then
            flag5 = true
            break
          end
        end
      end

      if flag5 then
        flag4 = true
        v39 = tick()
        task.delay(1.2, function() flag4 = false end)
        return
      end
    end

    if instance8.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude < 8 then
      return
    end

    v41:Dot(cframe.RightVector)
    flag4 = true
    v39 = tick()
    task.delay(1.2, function() flag4 = false end)
  end)

  function v4.setDive(enabled)
    v38.enabled = enabled
  end

  function v4.setDiveRange(range)
    v38.range = range
  end

  local function getToggle(p22, key22, p23)
    local default = p23.Default and true or false
    local flag6 = false
    v43[key22] = p23.Notify or { p23.Title, "Ativado.", "Desativado.", "info" }

    local toggle = p22:Toggle({
      Title = p23.Title,
      Desc = p23.Desc,
      Value = default,
      Callback = function(value20)
        if flag6 then
          return
        end

        default = value20 and true or false
        p23.OnChange(default)

        if p23.Notify then
          f1(p23.Notify[1], default and p23.Notify[2] or p23.Notify[3], p23.Notify[4])
        end
      end,
    })

    map5[key22] = {
      Get = function() return default end,
      Set = function(p24)
        default = p24 and true or false
        p23.OnChange(default)
        flag6 = false
      end,
    }

    return toggle
  end

  local function getSlider(p25, key23, p26)
    local default2 = p26.Default
    local flag7 = false
    local title2 = p26.Title
    local desc = p26.Desc
    local step = p26.Step
    local min = p26.Min
    local max = p26.Max

    local slider = p25:Slider({
      Title = title2,
      Desc = desc,
      Step = step or 1,
      Value = { Min = min, Max = max, Default = p26.Default },
      Callback = function(value21)
        if flag7 then
          return
        end

        default2 = value21
        p26.OnChange(value21)
      end,
    })

    map5[key23] = {
      Get = function() return default2 end,
      Set = function(p27)
        local clamped = p27
        clamped = tonumber(clamped)

        if not clamped then
          return
        end

        clamped = math.clamp(clamped, p26.Min, p26.Max)
        default2 = clamped
        p26.OnChange(clamped)
        flag7 = true
        pcall(function() slider:Set(clamped) end)
        flag7 = false
      end,
    }

    return slider
  end

  local function getDropdown(p28, key24, p29)
    local default3 = p29.Default
    local flag8 = false

    local dropdown = p28:Dropdown({
      Title = p29.Title,
      Desc = p29.Desc,
      Values = p29.Values,
      Value = default3,
      Callback = function(value22)
        if flag8 then
          return
        end

        default3 = value22
        p29.OnChange(value22)
      end,
    })

    map5[key24] = {
      Get = function() return default3 end,
      Set = function(default4)
        if not table.find(p29.Values, default4) then
          return
        end

        default3 = default4
        p29.OnChange(default4)
        flag8 = false
      end,
    }

    return dropdown
  end

  local v44 = {
    W = true,
    A = true,
    S = true,
    D = true,
    Space = true,
    Q = true,
    E = true,
    T = true,
    F = true,
    Z = true,
    C = true,
    H = true,
    RightShift = true,
    Unknown = true,
  }

  local v45 = {}
  local v46 = {}

  local function f23(key25, name2)
    map6[key25] = name2
  end

  local v47

  userInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input4, p30)
    if v47 then
      if input4.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
        return
      end

      local v48 = v47
      local name3 = input4.KeyCode.Name
      v47 = nil

      if name3 == "Escape" then
        f23(v48, map6[v48])
        f1("ATALHOS", "Cancelado.", "info")
        return
      elseif name3 == "Backspace" then
        f23(v48, "Nenhuma")
        f1("ATALHOS", v46[v48] .. ": atalho removido.", "check")
        return
      end

      if v44[name3] then
        f23(v48, map6[v48])
        f1("ATALHOS", "A tecla " .. name3 .. " não pode ser usada.", "info")
        return
      end

      for key26, value23 in pairs(map6) do
        if key26 ~= v48 and value23 == name3 then
          f23(key26, "Nenhuma")
        end
      end

      f23(v48, name3)
      f1("ATALHOS", v46[v48] .. ": " .. name3, "check")
      return
    elseif p30 then
      return
    end

    if input4.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
      return
    end

    local name4 = input4.KeyCode.Name

    for key27, value24 in pairs(map6) do
      if value24 ~= "Nenhuma" and value24 == name4 then
        local v49 = map5[key27]
        local v50 = v43[key27]

        if v49 then
          local v51 = not v49.Get()
          v49.Set(v51)

          if v50 then
            f1(v50[1], v51 and v50[2] or v50[3], v50[4])
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end)

  local function getIsfolder2()
    return writefile and readfile and isfile and makefolder and isfolder
  end

  local function f24()
    if not isfolder("NexoraHub") then
      makefolder("NexoraHub")
    end

    if not isfolder("NexoraHub/configs") then
      makefolder("NexoraHub/configs")
    end
  end

  local function getGsub(p31)
    local gsub = tostring(p31 or ""):gsub("[^%w_%-]", "")

    if gsub == "" then
      gsub = "padrao"
    end

    return gsub
  end

  local function f25(p32)
    local v52 = p32

    if not getIsfolder2() then
      return false, "Seu executor não suporta salvar arquivos."
    end

    v52 = getGsub(v52)
    local v53 = {}

    for key28, value25 in pairs(map5) do
      v53[key28] = value25.Get()
    end

    local ok5, result5 = pcall(function()
      f24()
      writefile("NexoraHub/configs" .. "/" .. v52 .. ".json", httpService:JSONEncode(v53))
    end)

    if ok5 then
      return true, "Config salva: " .. v52
    end

    return false, "Erro ao salvar: " .. tostring(result5)
  end

  local function f26(p33)
    if not getIsfolder2() then
      return false, "Seu executor não suporta ler arquivos."
    end

    local gsub2 = getGsub(p33)
    local v54 = "NexoraHub/configs" .. "/" .. gsub2 .. ".json"

    if not isfile(v54) then
      return false, "Config não encontrada: " .. gsub2
    end

    local ok6, result6 = pcall(function() return httpService:JSONDecode(readfile(v54)) end)

    if not ok6 or type(result6) ~= "table" then
      return false, "Arquivo de config inválido."
    end

    flag = true

    for key29, value26 in pairs(result6) do
      local v55 = map5[key29]

      if v55 then
        pcall(v55.Set, value26)
      end
    end

    flag = false
    return true, "Config carregada: " .. gsub2
  end

  local function f27(p34)
    if not (getIsfolder2() and delfile) then
      return false, "Seu executor não suporta apagar arquivos."
    end

    local gsub3 = getGsub(p34)
    local v56 = "NexoraHub/configs" .. "/" .. gsub3 .. ".json"

    if not isfile(v56) then
      return false, "Config não encontrada: " .. gsub3
    end

    pcall(delfile, v56)
    return true, "Config apagada: " .. gsub3
  end

  local function f28()
    local v57 = listfiles
    local nexoraHubConfigs = v57
    local list7 = {}

    if v57 then
      nexoraHubConfigs = isfolder and isfolder("NexoraHub/configs")
    end

    if nexoraHubConfigs then
      local ok7, v58 = pcall(listfiles, "NexoraHub/configs")

      if ok7 then
        for _, value27 in ipairs(v58) do
          local json = tostring(value27):match("([^/\\]+)%.json$")

          if json then
            table.insert(list7, json)
          end
        end
      end
    end

    return list7
  end

  local function f29()
    if getIsfolder2() and isfile("NexoraHub/autoload.txt") then
      local ok8, v59 = pcall(readfile, "NexoraHub/autoload.txt")

      if ok8 and v59 and v59 ~= "" then
        return getGsub(v59)
      end
    end

    return nil
  end

    Title = "Abrir / Fechar Nexora",
    Desc = "Clique para escolher outra tecla.",
    Value = "RightShift",
    CanChange = true,
    Callback = function(value53)
      local v72

      if typeof(value53) == "EnumItem" then
        v72 = value53
      elseif typeof(value53) == "string" then
        v72 = Enum.KeyCode[value53]
      end

      if not v72 then
        return
      end

      local ok10, result8 = pcall(function() nexoraWindow:SetToggleKey(v72) end)

      if not ok10 then
        warn("[NEXORA KEYBIND]", result8)
      end
    end,
  })

  configuraEsTab:Button({

  local v73 = "padrao"

  v73 = f29() or "padrao"

  configuraEsTab:Toggle({
    Title = "Carregar automaticamente",
    Desc = "Carrega essa config ao abrir o hub.",
    Value = f29() ~= nil,
    Callback = function(value55)
      if not getIsfolder2() then
        f1("CONFIGURAÇÕES", "Seu executor não suporta salvar arquivos.", "info")
        return
      end

      pcall(function()
        if value55 then
          f24()
          writefile("NexoraHub/autoload.txt", v73)
        elseif isfile("NexoraHub/autoload.txt") and delfile then
          delfile("NexoraHub/autoload.txt")
        end
      end)
    end,
  })

  sobreTab:Paragraph({

end

local function makeTextLabel(text)
  warn("[Nexora] " .. tostring(text))

  pcall(function()
    local nexoraError = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    nexoraError.Name = "NexoraError"
    nexoraError.ResetOnSpawn = false
    nexoraError.DisplayOrder = 1000000
    nexoraError.Parent = gethui and gethui() or coreGui

    local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 170)
    textLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.05, 0)
    textLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 0, 0)
    textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 210)
    textLabel.TextWrapped = true
    textLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    textLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    textLabel.TextSize = 12
    textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code

    textLabel.Text = "[Nexora] Erro (copiado para a área de transferência):\n"
      .. tostring(text)

    textLabel.Parent = nexoraError

    if setclipboard then
      setclipboard(tostring(text))
    end

    task.delay(40, function() nexoraError:Destroy() end)
  end)
end

local function f32()
  task.spawn(function()
    local ok11, result9 = xpcall(makeTextButton, function(p35)
      return tostring(p35) .. "\n" .. tostring(debug.traceback())
    end)

    if not ok11 then
      makeTextLabel(result9)
    end
  end)
end

f32()
